subject: Pricing reset: renewal staging, uplift credits and commit cadence
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal ask: 2028 renewal + capacity increase

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks for the meeting earlier — quick follow-up from our finance and infra teams. We expect a sustained increase in inference volume starting Q3 (attached forecast) and want to lock in renewal terms by mid-July. Two asks from our side: 1) a temporary price-lock for Q3 to avoid immediate uplift while we stabilize usage, and 2) a credit overlay or true-up mechanism that covers the first two months of the uplift if usage spikes above forecast.

High level: we are targeting a 12-month renewal with a modest committed uplift (approx +30% base commit) but need predictability for at least the quarter. Can you share a clean term sheet with an option for a short-term price hold + credit buffer? Also cc'd Tom Weaver from procurement — he may handle contract redlines.

Attachments: 2028-06-30-aurora-q3-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of Platform Operations
Aurora Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask: 2028 renewal + capacity increase

Hi Elena — thanks for the clarity and for the forecast. We can absolutely build a renewal that provides the predictability you're asking for. Two pragmatic options to consider (summary below) — I attached a draft term sheet for optioning.

Option A — 12 months (recommended for flexibility)
- 8% list discount on tokens across the committed tier
- 90-day price-lock on model rates (covers Q3 ramp)
- 2-month surge credit pool sized to your 30% uplift forecast (true-up applied against next invoice)
- Committed burst capacity increase with consumption-tier caps to avoid unlimited overage

Option B — 24 months (lower unit price, longer commitment)
- 12% list discount on tokens on committed baseline
- 6-month stepped price-lock, with step-downs tied to volume milestones
- Larger credit allocation but requires a higher baseline commit

Next steps: if Aurora prefers Option A, we can draft an amendment that includes the 90-day pricing freeze and a credit schedule (example in attached PDF). If you want us to route this for an expedited sign-off, Ben from Commercial Finance will confirm the final discount and credit sizing.

Attachments: redwood-renewal-term-draft-2028-v2.pdf (term sheet draft)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if Tom would like us to walk through the amendment.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales — Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask: 2028 renewal + capacity increase

Karthik / Monica — quick internal note before we send final language to Aurora: Finance is comfortable with an 8% discount + a 2-month credit buffer sized to the forecast if we require the customer to commit to the +30% baseline uplift for the first 90 days. If we want to go to 10% we'd need a 12-month prepayment or an increased baseline commit.

Suggested approach to close fast:
- Offer Option A (8% + 90-day price-lock + 2-month credit).
- Add clause: if Aurora's actuals exceed forecast by >25% after the 90-day lock, then standard overage rates apply unless amended by mutual consent.
- Request procurement to sign the amendment within 10 business days to lock Q3 prices.

I'll queue this for an internal approval ticket and can draft the finance sign-off block.

Ben Carter
Pricing & Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@aurorahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask: 2028 renewal + capacity increase

Karthik / Ben / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround. Aurora is aligned to proceed with Option A (12-month renewal with the 8% discount, 90-day price-lock, and the 2-month surge credit pool sized per the attached forecast). Tom will route the amendment for final review; please send the sample amendment language (we need explicit wording for the price-lock and the credit true-up mechanics).

Can you also include a one-paragraph summary we can share with our CFO (simple bullet list of financial impact this quarter vs rolling month-to-month)? That will help expedite procurement approval. Targeting signature by July 12.

Appreciate the help — looping Tom on next steps.

Best,
Elena
